description: O objetivo deste projeto é desenvolver um Mod Client-Side (lado do cliente) para Minecraft Java Edition, construído sobre o ecossistema Fabric. O foco central é alcançar a paridade visual da interface gráfica (GUI) e da experiência de usuário (UX) em relação à edição Bedrock.a

releases.notes:
**The Minecraft Bedrock interface, on Java Edition.** A client-side mod — it does not need
to be on the server, and works on any server unchanged.

*Mod client-side de paridade visual com a GUI/UX do Bedrock. Não precisa estar no servidor.*

## Requirements / Requisitos

| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 26.2 |
| Fabric Loader | 0.19.3+ |
| Fabric API | required / obrigatório |
| Java | **25** |

Java 25 is not optional — it is what Minecraft 26.2 itself requires.

## What's in this release

**HUD** — Paper Doll (facing you, body following your movement, going horizontal with an
elytra) and Bedrock-format coordinates.

**Screens** — main menu with the head following your cursor independently of the body;
pause menu; inventory with Bedrock's panel, slots and crafting arrow; screen transitions
and loading screen with the animated saving icon.

**Also** — UI click sounds, and Bedrock's palette sampled pixel by pixel from real
screenshots.

Every feature can be turned off individually in `config/bedrockux.json`.

## ⚠️ Known issue: shader packs (Iris)

**With a shader pack active, the 3D player model on the main menu renders distorted.** The
mod detects this and swaps it for a 2D face from your skin, with a blink.

This is a workaround, not a fix. The menu model goes through the *entity* rendering path,
which the shader replaces and which expects world data — and there is no world on the title
screen. That is also why entering a world and coming back "fixes" it, and why the HUD Paper
Doll never suffers from it.

Turn off `titleScreen.hideModelWithShaders` to see the 3D model anyway.

*Com shader ativo, o modelo do menu inicial aparece deformado e o mod troca pelo rosto da
skin em 2D. É contorno, não conserto — a causa está fora do alcance do mod.*

## Not in scope yet

Creative inventory, and the fog tweak (off by default, not validated with Sodium). Water
and chat margins were dropped because modern Java already handles both natively.
